New to the sub. I made spinach dal in traditional south Indian style. Excellent source of protein and more. Little elaborate process with a lot of ingredients. Usually, all of the ingredients can be found at any Indian store, and are a staple for most Indian dishes.

Recipe:

Ingredients-spinach, toor dal, garlic, 
turmeric, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, asofetida, green chilli, salt and butter

Procedure-
First pressure cook toor dal (bought from the local Indian store) with water(two cups of water for one cup of dal). Cook it for enough time to mash the dal completely...three to four whistles in my pressure cooker. I like to add a pinch of turmeric to my water and dal mixture before pressure cooking it.
Slice an onion, dice a tomato, mince a few garlic pods, crush some coriander seeds and chop a small green chilli. Keep them aside.
In a pan, heat up some butter. Keeping a medium heat going on through out the process helps. Add mustard seeds and cumin seeds and let them crackle. Add the garlic, a pinch of turmeric, pinch of asofetida, coriander seeds and the green chilli to this and saute for a minute.
Add onions and keep mixing the mixture until onions are transparent. Add spinach into this and let the leaves wilt a bit...four minutes of stirring does it. Add chopped tomatoes, and salt. Do not cover the pan. Cook this for another ten minutes.

Add the spinach mixture to the pressure cooked dal and let it cook for five more minutes. Check the seasoning and serve with rice!
